issues.where: Paint macro, 9–14.97 s; lower-third crease and upper half
issues.what: The wide retains a diagonal, but neither format reveals a distinct panel landmark over the glide. In portrait the crease sits low and flattens toward the end, leaving most of the frame without a feature to follow.
issues.fix: Keep the continuous macro glide but carry it past a panel edge or seam. Give portrait its own more oblique camera path so the crease travels diagonally through the middle of the frame.

issues.where: Portrait ignition, rear fascia between the towers and foreground deck
issues.what: The car fills most of the width but very little of the height. The nearly horizontal rear fascia makes the exhaust area feel secondary to the surroundings.
issues.fix: Keep the low camera height, but move slightly closer and farther around the rear quarter so the near wheel and tail form a stronger diagonal. Trade some foreground deck for more rear fascia without cutting off the tail.

issues.where: Portrait wake, final frame; car in lower third
issues.what: The skyline still carries much of the arrival framing at the end of wake, leaving the front three-quarter reveal visually low in the frame.
issues.fix: Ease the aim down during the existing push and settle slightly tighter on the nose and nearer lamp, keeping one tower for scale and the full car within frame.
